tools.description:
Return the meaning, cause, and recommended handling for a project error
code. Use when an error code appears in logs, a stack trace, or an API
response. Codes match the pattern E followed by four digits.
tools.name: lookup_error_code

tools.description:
Return the configuration schema for one named service: keys, types,
defaults, and which keys are required. Use before generating or editing a
service configuration file. Returns the schema only, never the values from
any environment.
tools.name: get_config_schema

tools.description:
Search the project architecture documentation and return the matching
sections, up to max_sections. Use when a question concerns how services
relate, why a design decision was made, or where a responsibility lives.
Returns sections, not whole documents.
tools.name: find_architecture_docs

content.text:
KEY                    TYPE      REQUIRED  DEFAULT              NOTES
PAYMENT_API_KEY        string    True      (value not shown)    Provider API key for this environment.
PAYMENT_BASE_URL       string    True      None                 Provider endpoint. Sandbox and live endpoints differ.
PROVIDER_REGION        string    False     us                   Provider region; must match the merchant account.
CAPTURE_TIMEOUT        integer   False     30                   Seconds to wait for a capture call before failing it.
CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES  integer   False     15                   Minutes after authorization that the capture worker captures.
AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES      integer   False     60                   Minutes the provider holds an authorization. Must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES or holds lapse before capture.
WEBHOOK_SECRET         string    True      (value not shown)    Shared secret for verifying provider webhooks.
MAX_CAPTURE_RETRIES    integer   False     4                    Capture retries on retryable provider errors.
